
/* ── Global ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
QWidget {
    background-color: #252526;
    color: #cccccc;
    font-family: "Inter", sans-serif;
    font-size: 13px;
}
/* Captions are transparent by default.  The ``QWidget`` rule above also
   matches every ``QLabel``, so each caption painted the window surface on top
   of its parent.  Inside a hovered row (``#toolRow:hover`` = surface.3) the
   glyph/value/badge labels then read as grey stripes over the highlight
   (2026-10-25).  A more specific rule (``#id`` or a widget-local sheet) still
   overrides this one where a label really needs a fill. */
QLabel {
    background: transparent;
}
QMainWindow {
    background-color: #1e1e1e;
}
QDialog {
    border: 1px solid #858585;
    background-color: #252526;
    color: #cccccc;
}
QScrollArea {
    background-color: #252526;
    border: none;
}
QScrollBar:vertical {
    background: #333333;
    width: 10px;
    margin: 0;
}
QScrollBar::handle:vertical {
    background: #3c3c3c;
    min-height: 30px;
    border-radius: 5px;
}
QScrollBar::handle:vertical:hover {
    background: #858585;
}
QScrollBar::add-line:vertical, QScrollBar::sub-line:vertical {
    height: 0;
}
QScrollBar:horizontal {
    background: #333333;
    height: 10px;
    margin: 0;
}
QScrollBar::handle:horizontal {
    background: #3c3c3c;
    min-width: 30px;
    border-radius: 5px;
}
QScrollBar::handle:horizontal:hover {
    background: #858585;
}
QScrollBar::add-line:horizontal, QScrollBar::sub-line:horizontal {
    width: 0;
}

/* ── Line Edit ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
QLineEdit {
    placeholder-text-color: #858585;
    selection-background-color: #007acc;
    selection-color: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid #3c3c3c;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 6px 10px;
    color: #cccccc;
    background: #333333;
    font-size: 13px;
}
QLineEdit:focus {
    border: 1px solid #007acc;
}
/* The clear button of a QLineEdit is a QToolButton Qt creates itself, and it
   used to inherit the button chrome further down (6 px of padding, a border,
   a 24 px minimum height): inside a 28 px field it then measured 22 × 38, so
   the «×» was drawn half below the field and cut by its bottom edge — the
   «смещённая кнопка удалить текст справа поля» of the 2026-10-23 list.  Two
   type selectors out-specify one, so this keeps the field's own button quiet
   wherever the field lives (the panel search, the PACS dialog, the picker). */
QLineEdit QToolButton {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 3px;
    padding: 0px;
    margin: 0px;
    min-height: 0px;
    min-width: 0px;
    font-weight: 400;
}
QLineEdit QToolButton:hover {
    background: #454545;
    border: none;
}
QLineEdit QToolButton:pressed {
    background: #2d2d2d;
    border: none;
}

/* ── Tabs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
QTabWidget::pane {
    border: 1px solid #3c3c3c;
    background: #252526;
    top: -1px;
    border-radius: 8px;
}
/* Document tabs are quiet chips, not outlined cards (design A1, «визуал
   кнопок»): the active study is told apart by a filled pill and brighter text,
   and the outline that framed every tab — the selected one included — is gone.
   The 8 px corners that met the content edge went with it: a free-standing pill
   needs all four corners rounded. */
QTabBar::tab {
    background: transparent;
    color: #858585;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    padding: 7px 14px;
    margin-right: 4px;
    min-width: 72px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
}
QTabBar::tab:selected {
    background: #333333;
    color: #cccccc;
    font-weight: 600;
    border-radius: 6px;
}
QTabBar::tab:hover:!selected {
    background: #454545;
    color: #cccccc;
}

/* ── Buttons ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* The ui-redesign button contract (mockup `button()`): radius 6, a quiet
   resting surface, and a checked/active control that reads as tinted accent —
   16 % fill, 50 % border, accent caption — instead of the old outlined chip. */

    color: #cccccc;

/* ── SystemBar ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#systemBar {
    /* The ground is the window's own: the patient line is a band of chrome, not
       a second surface.  Only the hairline below it separates the chrome from
       the tool row (2026-10-27 list, item 5a: «одна hairline»). */
    background: transparent;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #3c3c3c;
    min-height: 34px;
}
#preferencesTitleBar {
    background: #252526;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #3c3c3c;
    min-height: 34px;
}
#systemBar QPushButton, #systemBar QToolButton {
    min-height: 23px;
    max-height: 23px;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 500;
    /* The action row is text + glyph on the bar itself (§4.1, A1), not a line of
       boxed chips: a filled, bordered rectangle behind every caption made the
       row loud and moved it away from the design. */
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 4px;
}
#systemBar QPushButton:hover, #systemBar QToolButton:hover {
    background: #454545;
    border-color: transparent;
}
#systemBar QPushButton:pressed, #systemBar QToolButton:pressed {
    background: #2d2d2d;
}
#systemBar QPushButton:checked, #systemBar QToolButton:checked {
    background: #1f3341;
    border-color: #125079;
    color: #4daaf0;
}
#systemBar QPushButton:disabled, #systemBar QToolButton:disabled {
    color: #858585;
    background: transparent;
}
#systemBarSeparator {
    background: #3c3c3c;
    border: none;
    max-width: 1px;
    min-width: 1px;
}
/* «PACS ▾» is a QToolButton with InstantPopup: the menu-indicator glyph of the
   style was drawn as a stray dash under the right edge and pushed the caption
   down relative to the neighbouring QPushButtons. The button opens the menu on
   the first click, so no arrow is needed; hide it and keep the metrics of the
   buttons it sits between. */
#systemBar QToolButton::menu-indicator {
    image: none;
    width: 0;
    height: 0;
}
#systemBarContext, #systemBarActions {
    background: transparent;
}
/* «Справочник» is an ordinary action of the row: the accent outline it used to
   carry made one of five equal buttons look selected. */
#systemBar QPushButton#referencesButton {
    border-color: transparent;
}
/* «Сброс» is an ordinary action of the row, not an alert (2026-10-27 list,
   item 4: «сделать обычным цветом, не красным»).  A red fill next to eight
   neutral captions made a rarely used command the loudest control of the
   window and pulled the eye away from the image.  The destructive nature is
   carried by the confirmation dialog, not by a permanent red patch. */
#systemBar QPushButton#resetButton {
    background: transparent;
    border-color: transparent;
    color: #858585;
}
#systemBar QPushButton#resetButton:hover {
    background: #454545;
    border-color: transparent;
    color: #cccccc;
}
#systemBar QPushButton#resetButton:pressed {
    background: #2d2d2d;
}

/* «Рост · Вес · ППТ» live in the patient line itself (2026-10-27 list, item
   5a): no ground and no hairline of their own — the row owns both, and a
   second border here drew a box inside the row.  Only the fields and their
   captions are styled: one field height for all three controls and one gap
   between the groups. */
#patientMetricsToolbarHost, #patientMetricsToolbar {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
}
#patientMetricsToolbar QLabel {
    color: #858585;
    font-size: 12px;
    background: transparent;
}
/* «ППТ: нет данных» is a derived value, not a warning: it used to inherit the
   amber attention fill of the worksheet and read as an error in the patient
   line. */
#patientMetricsToolbar QLabel#patientBsaLabel {
    color: #858585;
    background: transparent;
}
#patientMetricsToolbar QSpinBox, #patientMetricsToolbar QDoubleSpinBox {
    min-height: 24px;
    max-height: 24px;
    padding: 0 20px 0 6px;
    background: #333333;
    border: 1px solid #3c3c3c;

}

    border-color: #3c3c3c;
}
#patientMetricsToolbar QSpinBox:focus, #patientMetricsToolbar QDoubleSpinBox:focus {
    border-color: #007acc;
}

/* «Изображения | Отчёт» — one segmented control (spec §4.1, UD-08). The checked
   segment carries the accent fill; the unchecked one stays a quiet surface, so

   the outlined one is off». */

/* ── Tool buttons (row and rail, UI-2 PR-3) ──────────────────── */
/* The global QToolButton rule reserves 12 px of padding per side. In the fixed
   38 px cell of the row that left a 10 px glyph box, so the pictogram sat small
   and off-centre; the icon box is now the button box and the glyph is sized by
   ToolButtonsBase.ICON_EDGE. */
QToolButton[view="row"], QToolButton[view="rail"] {
    padding: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    min-width: 0;
}
/* The measurement strip is a toolbar, not a row of cards: a transparent
   control, a hover fill and the accent tint of the armed tool.  Nine bordered
   boxes above the image held more contrast than the frame itself. */
QToolButton[view="row"] {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 6px;
    color: #858585;
}
QToolButton[view="row"]:hover {
    background: #454545;
    border-color: transparent;
    color: #cccccc;
}
QToolButton[view="row"]:pressed {
    background: #2d2d2d;
    border-color: transparent;
}
QToolButton[view="row"]:checked {
    background: #1f3341;
    border-color: #125079;
    color: #4daaf0;
}
QToolButton[view="row"]:disabled {
    background: transparent;
    border-color: transparent;
    color: #858585;
}
QToolButton[view="row"]:checked, QToolButton[view="rail"]:checked {
    background: #1f3341;
    border-color: #125079;
    color: #4daaf0;
}
QToolButton[view="row"]:disabled, QToolButton[view="rail"]:disabled {
    color: #858585;
}
#toolButtonSeparator {
    background: #3c3c3c;
    max-width: 1px;
    min-width: 1px;
    border: none;
}

/* ── Tool-panel tabs and native overflow controls ───────────── */
/* The three destinations of the panel («Измерения | Калькуляторы |
   Управление») are *tabs of a section*, not documents of the workspace: the
   pill of a document tab read as a fourth button in the first row of the
   panel (2026-10-27 list).  An underline in the accent colour on a full-width
   hairline is the pattern the app-screen study gives a set of views; the pane
   keeps no frame, so the panel is one surface. */
#toolPanel QTabWidget::pane {
    border: none;
    background: #252526;
}
#toolPanel QTabBar {
    background: #252526;
}
#toolPanel QTabBar::tab {
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 6px 0 5px 0;
    margin-right: 18px;
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 0;
    color: #858585;
